newsitem.title: MOROCCO: Morocco and Swedish firm sign accord to seek oil.
newsitem.headline: Morocco and Swedish firm sign accord to seek oil.

text.p: Morocco and a Swedish firm have signed a deal under which the Swedes will carry out seismic and geological research for oil off the southern Moroccan coast, the official news agency MAP said on Wednesday.
It said that if the initial research, to be carried out over 12 months, proved promising, the two sides would enter into an eight-year contract to prospect the offshore zone.
Under this contract, up to seven exploratory wells costing up to $42 million would be drilled.
The accord was signed between the Swedish Taurus Petroleum Aktiebolag and Moroccan state-owned Office National de Recherches et d'Exploitation Petrolieres (ONAREP) on Monday, the agency said.
